answer.rationale: The 24-hour reporting obligation under §1904.39(a)(2) applies only to in-patient hospitalizations that result from a work-related incident. The scenario does not establish whether the illness was work-related or whether the hospitalization was for in-patient treatment, both of which are material predicates for triggering the reporting duty.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Need confirmation whether the employee's illness was work-related and whether the hospital admission constituted formal in-patient treatment, as both facts determine whether the 24-hour OSHA notification requirement is triggered.
